displayedInputs.question: 20 books were checked out on Monday, and 15 books were checked out on Tuesday. How many fewer books were checked out on Tuesday than on Monday? Calculate: \(20-15=\,?\)

Exactly one item is known to be lighter than all the others, which have equal mass. To find it efficiently with a two-pan balance, how should you divide the remaining candidate items before a weighing?

choices.A: Into 3 groups as evenly as possible, with two equally sized groups to compare
choices.C: Weighing all the items together once is enough

displayedInputs.question: There are 81 parts, divided into 3 groups each time. How many parts are in each group the first time? Calculate: \(81\div3=\,?\)
Each bottle contains \(\frac{3}{5}\) liter of juice. How many liters are in 4 bottles altogether? Calculate: \(\frac{3}{5}\times4=\,?\)

\(\frac{1}{2}\) of a road has been repaired, and \(\frac{2}{3}\) of that was repaired in the morning. What fraction of the entire road was repaired in the morning? Calculate: \(\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{2}{3}=\,?\)
A bucket contains 30 liters of oil, and \(\frac{2}{5}\) of it is used. How many liters are used? Calculate: \(30\times\frac{2}{5}=\,?\)
The school is located 800 meters from the shop in a direction \(40^\circ\) east of north. Only the distance in meters is being asked for. Calculate: \(800+0=\,?\)
First travel 120 meters east, then 80 meters south. How many meters are the 2 sections in total? Calculate: \(120 + 80 = ?\)
A rope \(\frac{3}{4}\) of a meter long is cut into 3 equal pieces. How many meters long is each piece? Calculate: \(\frac{3}{4} \div 3 = ?\)
\(\frac{6}{7}\) of a sheet of paper is divided into equal portions, each \(\frac{2}{7}\) of a sheet. How many portions can be made? Calculate: \((\frac{6}{7}) \div (\frac{2}{7}) = ?\)
A road is being repaired. \(\frac{2}{5}\) of it has been repaired, covering 8 kilometers. How many kilometers long is the entire road? Calculate: \(8 \div (\frac{2}{5}) = ?\)
What is the result called when the first term of a ratio is divided by its second term?
